<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,7)>This place looks good—there’s a lotta room! OK, just a sec.
<$comeff(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,7)><$voicel(2,10)>Heeere it is!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,6)>The town looks so much prettier... <$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,5)><$voicel(2,8)>And there are so many
Pokémon here now!
<$comeff(2,8)><$motion(2,826)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,9)>Thank yooouuu, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! I’m SO happy!

<$emotion(2,27)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, and I just remembered! <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,5)><$voicel(2,6)>I found something neat while
you were working hard!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,839)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,8)>Lemme show you as thanks for the help!

<$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,3)>Oh, but... I’m not sure there’s enough room right here.
<$emotion(2,48)><$voicel(2,8)>Let’s go somewhere with more space!

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>Whatcha think? Looks pretty neat, huh? <$emotion(2,65)><$voicel(2,2)>I think it’s some
kinda thingy the humans used.

<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,838)><$facial(2,5)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, wow! So if we use this, <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,655)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)>do you think we can make the
town even shinier and sparklier?!

<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,838)><$facial(2,5)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, wow! So if we use this, <$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,655)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)>do you think we can make the
town even shinier and sparklier?!

<$emotion(2,13)><$voicel(2,3)>But we prolly need a whole buncha Pokémon to help us

<$emotion(2,48)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>OK, let’s find all my underwater buddies and ask ’em
to help us out!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Um, lemme see... First there’s the one with the cute
coral horns...<$emotion(2,13)><$facial(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>and the one who’s really good with their
big claws.
<$facial(2,2)><$voicel(2,3)>Then there’s the shy, spiky one, and the kinda wild one

Oh, and the one with the charming whiskers...<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,654)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,7)>and the

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,10)><$voicel(2,6)>Yeah, I know... <wait(1.8)><$comeff(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)>But I’m so excited to see them all again!
<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,10)><$voicel(2,6)>Yeah, sorry! <wait(1.8)><$comeff(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,4)><$voicel(2,8)>But I’m so excited to see them all again!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,839)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>And if you wanna know more about any of ’em, you can
always come ask me!

<$voicel(1,4)>might get damaged!

<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>appears to be working just fine...

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,32)>I recommend you find it and start there.

<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,9)>I suspect the <$cdef(27)>PC at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center will prove

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,65)>When you finish gathering the stuff we need, please bring

<$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>I’m sure that town must look quite different now compared
to when the humans were there.
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>But if they come back to find so many Pokémon living
happily there...
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m sure they’ll be very pleased when they return!

<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I hope you’ll continue working together with your friends
there <$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,8)>to make an even more comfortable town
bustling with Pokémon!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>I’ll be cheering you on from here!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,92)><$pkcry;0(2,2)>! It’s so big, and...SO FANTASTIC! <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,9)>It’s so

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,113)>Thanks for getting everything ready for the big
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing project! You can leave the rest to us!

<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,55)>Everybody’s really fired up and ready to roll, so this might

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,661)><$facial(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)>You’re gonna love it when it’s done!
<$voicel(2,6)><$emotion(2,8)>Maybe there’s somebody in there!
<$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,5)>There’s no WAY I could’ve built this all by myself!

everybody

<$voicel(2,7)>Ta-daaa! This is my town! Isn’t it nice?
